value.rationale: A natural double-absorber counterpart of quantum gambler’s ruin is classified exactly at all finite lengths, revealing completely flat interior branching unlike the linearly varying classical profile. The competing-loss, quantum-Zeno rate tradeoff has a unique universal a=2J optimizer regardless of rival b and chain length. This is an operationally meaningful, nonroutine two-target classification, not an arbitrary finite instance or a direct restatement of one-sink times.
